mn41:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Sālā nāma Kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tad-avasari.
mn41:2.2: Samaṇo khalu bho Gotamo Sakyaputto Sakyakulā pabbajito Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhim Sālaṃ anuppatto;
mn41:2.3: taṃ kho pana bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn41:2.4: Iti pi so Bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā.
mn41:2.5: So imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn41:2.6: So dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ,
mn41:2.8: Sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotīti.
mn41:3.1: Atha kho Sāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā app-ekacce Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app-ekacce Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu, sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app-ekacce yena Bhagavā ten' añjalim-paṇāmetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app-ekacce Bhagavato santike nāmagottaṃ sāvetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu, app-ekacce tuṇhībhūtā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. Ekamantaṃ nisinnā kho Sāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavantaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn41:4.1: Ko nu kho bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti;
mn41:4.2: ko pana bho Gotama hetu ko paccayo yena-m-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti. --
mn41:5.1: Adhammacariyā-visamacariyāhetu kho gahapatayo evam-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti;
mn41:5.2: dhammacariyā-samacariyāhetu kho gahapatayo evam-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjantīti. \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ --
mn41:6.1: Na kho mayaṃ imassa bhoto Gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāma;
mn41:6.2: sādhu no bhavaṅ-Gotamo tathā dhammaṃ desetu yathā mayaṃ imassa bhoto Gotamassa saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ avibhattassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājāneyyāmāti. --
mn41:6.3: Tena hi gahapatayo suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasikarotha, bhāsissāmīti.
mn41:6.4: Evaṃ bho ti kho Sāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn41:7.1: Tividhaṃ kho gahapatayo kāyena adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti, tividhaṃ manasā adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti.
mn41:8.1: Kathañ-ca gahapatayo tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti:
mn41:8.2: Idha gahapatayo ekacco pāṇātipātī hoti luddo lohitapāṇi hatapahate niviṭṭho adayāpanno pāṇabhūtesu.
mn41:8.3: Adinnādāyī kho pana hoti, yan-taṃ parassa paravittūpakaraṇaṃ gāmagataṃ vā araññagataṃ vā taṃ adinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.
mn41:8.4: Kāmesu micchācārī kho pana hoti, yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā [mātāpiturakkhitā] bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā sassāmikā saparidaṇḍā, antamaso mālāguṇaparikkhittā pi, tathārūpāsu cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti.
mn41:8.5: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo tividhaṃ kāyena adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti.
mn41:9.1: Kathañ-ca gahapatayo catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti:
mn41:9.2: Idha gahapatayo ekacco musāvādī hoti, sabhāgato vā parisagato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho: evaṃ bho purisa yaṃ jānāsi taṃ vadehīti, so ajānaṃ vā āha: jānāmīti, jānaṃ vā āha: na jānāmīti, apassaṃ vā āha: passāmīti, passaṃ vā āha: na passāmīti; iti attahetu vā parahetu vā āmisakiñcikkhahetu vā sampajānamusā bhāsitā hoti.
mn41:9.3: Pisuṇāvāco kho pana hoti, ito sutvā amutra akkhātā imesaṃ bhedāya amutra vā sutvā imesaṃ akkhātā amūsaṃ bhedāya, iti samaggānaṃ vā bhettā bhinnānaṃ vā anuppadātā, vaggārāmo vaggarato vagganandī vaggakaraṇiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn41:9.4: Pharusāvāco kho pana hoti, yā sā vācā aṇḍakā kakkasā parakaṭukā parābhisajjanī kodhasāmantā asamādhisaṃvattanikā, \ [... content straddling page break has been moved to the page above ...] \ tathārūpiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā hoti.
mn41:9.5: Samphappalāpī kho pana hoti, akālavādī abhūtavādī anatthavādī adhammavādī avinayavādī, anidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā akālena anapadesaṃ apariyantavatiṃ anatthasaṃhitaṃ.
mn41:9.6: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo catubbidhaṃ vācāya adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti.
mn41:10.1: Kathañ-ca gahapatayo tividhaṃ manasā adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti:
mn41:10.2: Idha gahapatayo ekacco abhijjhālu hoti, yan-taṃ parassa paravittūpakaraṇaṃ taṃ abhijjhātā hoti: aho vata yaṃ parassa taṃ mama assāti.
mn41:10.3: Byāpannacitto kho pana hoti paduṭṭhamanasaṅkappo: ime sattā haññantu vā vajjhantu vā ucchijjantu vā vinassantu vā mā vā ahesuṃ iti vā
mn41:10.4: ti. Micchādiṭṭhi kho pana hoti viparītadassano:
mn41:10.5: na-tthi dinnaṃ na-tthi yiṭṭhaṃ na-tthi hutaṃ, na-tthi sukaṭadukkaṭānaṃ kammānaṃ phalaṃ vipāko, natthi ayaṃ loko na-tthi paro loko, na-tthi mātā na-tthi pitā na-tthi sattā opapātikā, na-tthi loke samaṇabrāhmaṇā sammaggatā sammāpaṭipannā ye imañ-ca lokaṃ parañ-ca lokaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedentīti.
mn41:10.6: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo tividhaṃ manasā adhammacariyā-visamacariyā hoti.
mn41:10.7: Evaṃ adhammacariyā-visamacariyāhetu kho gahapatayo evam-idh' ekacce sattā kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjanti.
mn41:11.1: Tividhaṃ kho gahapatayo kāyena dhammacariyā-samacariyā hoti, catubbidhaṃ vācāya dhammacariyā-samacariyā hoti, tividhaṃ manasā dhammacariyā-samacariyā hoti.
mn41:12.1: Kathañ-ca gahapatayo tividhaṃ kāyena dhammacariyā-samacariyā hoti:
mn41:12.2: Idha gahapatayo ekacco pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti, nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharati.
mn41:12.3: Adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti, yan-taṃ parassa paravittūpakaraṇaṃ gāmagataṃ vā araññagataṃ vā taṃ nādinnaṃ theyyasaṅkhātaṃ ādātā hoti.
mn41:12.4: Kāmesu micchācāraṃ pahāya kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti, yā tā māturakkhitā piturakkhitā [mātāpiturakkhitā] bhāturakkhitā bhaginirakkhitā ñātirakkhitā sassāmikā saparidaṇḍā, antamaso mālāguṇaparikkhittā pi, tathārūpāsu na cārittaṃ āpajjitā hoti.
mn41:12.5: Evaṃ kho gahapatayo tividhaṃ kāyena dhammacariyāsamacariyā hoti. \ [...

mn41:18-42.2: aho vatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param-maraṇā Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ --pe--

mn41:43.2: aho vatāhaṃ āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyan-ti,
mn41:43.3: ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ so āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyya,
mn41:43.5: tathā hi so dhammacārī samacārī ti.
mn41:44.1: Evaṃ vutte Sāleyyakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā Bhagavantaṃ etad-avocuṃ:
mn41:44.2: Abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho Gotama.
mn41:44.3: Seyyathā pi bho Gotama nikujjitaṃ va ukkujjeyya, paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya, mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya, andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya: cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhintīti, evam-evaṃ bhotā Gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito.
mn41:44.4: Ete mayaṃ bhavantaṃ Gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāma dhammañ-ca bhikkhusaṅghañca.
mn41:44.5: Upāsake no bhavaṅ-Gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupete saraṇagate ti. 42.
